syllabusTopics: Core compute — EC2 (instance types, AMI, security groups, key pairs)
Auto Scaling & Load Balancing — ASG, ALB vs NLB, target groups, health checks
Serverless — Lambda (triggers, cold start, concurrency limits, layers)
Storage — S3 (buckets, storage classes, lifecycle, presigned URLs, versioning)
Block & file storage — EBS vs EFS vs Instance Store — when to use each
Databases — RDS (Multi-AZ vs Read Replica), Aurora, DynamoDB (partition key, GSI, LSI)
Caching — ElastiCache (Redis vs Memcached on AWS), DAX for DynamoDB
Networking — VPC, subnets (public vs private), NAT Gateway, Internet Gateway, security groups vs NACLs
DNS & CDN — Route 53 (routing policies), CloudFront (origins, cache behaviors, invalidation)
Messaging & eventing — SQS (standard vs FIFO, visibility timeout, DLQ), SNS, EventBridge
Containers — ECS vs EKS, Fargate vs EC2 launch type, ECR
IAM — users, roles, policies, assume-role, instance profiles, least privilege
Observability — CloudWatch (metrics, logs, alarms), X-Ray, CloudTrail
Infrastructure as Code — CloudFormation vs CDK vs Terraform (trade-offs)
Cost & reliability — Reserved vs On-Demand vs Spot, multi-AZ vs multi-region, RTO vs RPO
